text.en:
Barangays Gatub and Bagong Kahayag, both in the Municipality of Kumalarang and Barangays
Lakewood, Bolalawan, Sebugay, Bisuangan, Lokoan, Backing, Dagum, Sapang Pinolis, Tubod, Gasa, Tiwales
and Matalang, all in the Municipality of Lapuyan, are hereby detached and separated from their respective
municipalities and constituted into a distinct and independent municipality to be known as the Municipality of
Lakewood, in the province of Zamboanga del Sur. The seat of government of the newly created municipality
shall be in Barangay Lakewood.

Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law, now of hereafter applicable to regular
municipalities, shall be applicable to the Municipality of Lakewood.

The present elective municipal officials of the Municipality of Lapuyan shall continue to
perform their duties as such officials in the newly created Municipality of Lakewood until the municipal
officials of said municipality shall have been appointed by the President. Such officials so appointed shall
hold office until their successors shall have been elected in the regular elections for municipal officials,
following the issuance of this Decree and shall have qualified, unless sooner removed at the pleasure of the
President. Such appointive officers and employees as may be necessary to organize or to complete the
government personnel of the Municipality for under existing laws.

Upon the effectivity of this Decree, the proportionate share of Lakewood in the obligations,
funds, assets and other property of the Municipalities of Kumalarang and Lapuyan shall be transferred by the
President to the newly created municipality upon the recommendation of the Commission on Audit.

All laws or parts of laws as well as executive orders or regulations inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
